summary: Keep replacing the number by the sum of its digits until only one digit is left (T2 — digit manipulation). Turning the number into a string makes "its digits" easy to loop over.

blocks.title: Read the number
blocks.text: An `int`, because we compare it with 10 below.

blocks.title: Sum the digits until one digit remains
blocks.text: `while n >= 10` keeps going while there are 2+ digits — summing only once is a common mistake (65536 → 25, but the answer is 7). `str(n)` gives the digit characters and `int(d)` turns each back into a number.

blocks.title: Shortcut and output
blocks.text: The comment shows the O(1) formula `1 + (n - 1) % 9` (0 stays 0), handy for checking. Then print `Digital Root: 7`.

complexity: Time O(number of digits) per step and only a few steps — instant even for 2,000,000,000.
